map.高强度他汀一定更好吗？: Is a High-Intensity Statin Always Better?
map.对 ASCVD 极高危者，大幅降 LDL-C 更显著降低事件，多优选高强度；但老: For very high-risk ASCVD patients, larger LDL-C reductions lower events more clearly, so high intensity is often preferred; but for elderly, frail, hepatically or renally impaired, or myopathy-affected patients, weigh the options — moderate intensity plus ezetimibe or a PCSK9 inhibitor may be enough, and blind escalation should be avoided.
map.吃他汀要查什么？: What Should You Check When Taking a Statin?
map.用药前基线肝酶、肌酸激酶；4–12 周复查 LDL-C 达标与肝酶/CK；若出现: Check baseline liver enzymes and creatine kinase before starting; recheck at 4–12 weeks for LDL-C target attainment and liver enzymes/CK; seek care promptly for muscle pain, weakness, or tea-colored urine. Most people tolerate statins well — do not stop on rumor alone and let events rebound.
map.LDL-C 降不下来怎么办？: What If LDL-C Won't Come Down?
map.先确认依从性与剂量，仍高可联依折麦布或 PCSK9 抑制剂；同时管饮食、运动、戒: First confirm adherence and dose; if it stays high, combine with ezetimibe or a PCSK9 inhibitor, and manage diet, exercise, and smoking at the same time. The target depends on the risk stratum (often below 1.4 for very high risk) and is individualized by cardiology.
